title: Evaluating the Link Between Neighborhood Environments and Obesity Among African American Women
brief_summary: African American women have higher rates of obesity than women of any other racial or ethnic group in the United States. Obesity can have many causes, including genetic and environmental factors. This study will examine how neighborhood environments influence the occurrence of obesity among African American women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participating in the BWHS study
* Residing in New York, Los Angeles, or Chicago
study_population: The Black Women's Health Study cohort comprises 59,000 African American women recruited mainly from subscribers to Essence magazine who returned the baseline 1995 survey.
